content:
“You were always the odd kid.”

**Class Freak** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Reduces negative effects of mutations.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | The negative effects of your mutations are reduced by 75%. | 00391F12 | 
| ★★ | 2 | The negative effects of your mutations are reduced by 50%. | 00391F11 | 
| ★ | 1 | The negative effects of your mutations are reduced by 25%. | 00391F0E | 

- With this perk at max rank, the Egg Head mutation's downsides will show as "STR >-1 END >-1" in the Pip-Boy, as 75% of 3 is not an integer. The player's actual Strength and Endurance will be unaffected; however, stats derived from them such as carry weight, melee damage, the action point cost to sprint, disease chance, and health will be slightly reduced.

- Prior to patch 1.1.4.3, the perk appeared to have a visual bug on the effects page of the Pip-Boy, where it wouldn't show any reduction to the Empath and Herd Mentality negative effects while it would for the other mutations. The aforementioned patch corrected the interaction between the Empath, Class Freak and Strange in Numbers perk. [verified] - A similar issue still occurs, where upon first joining a server while having the perk equipped from a previous session, the Pip-Boy effects page will show no reduction to the negative effects of any mutation. Once again it is purely visual, and unequipping then reequipping the perk fixes the issue. [verified] 
- A similar issue still occurs, where upon first joining a server while having the perk equipped from a previous session, the Pip-Boy effects page will show no reduction to the negative effects of any mutation. Once again it is purely visual, and unequipping then reequipping the perk fixes the issue. 
- Prior to patch 1.1.4.3, Class Freak would not suppress the negative effects of the Grounded mutation.
- The perk does not suppress the downside of the Speed Demon mutation. [verified]
